title: Quorum Mode Governance Rules
description: JSON Schema for governance rules applied to macp.mode.quorum.v1 sessions. See RFC-MACP-0012 Section 4.2.

threshold.description: Override the required_approvals from ApprovalRequest (RFC-MACP-0012 Section 4.2). This is the approval bar and the ONLY gate in schema_version <= 2 — there is no separate participation quorum. Type 'n_of_m' uses a raw approval count, 'percentage' uses an integer percentage (0-100) of eligible participants, 'weighted' uses a weighted sum of participant weights.

value.description: Threshold value: approval count for n_of_m, integer percentage 0-100 for percentage, weighted sum for weighted.

counts_toward_quorum.description: If true, abstentions count toward the participation quorum but not toward approval.

interpretation.description: How abstentions are interpreted for threshold calculation.
